The three .toml files are copied unmodified from that commit's
extras/alacritty/. They are the theme author's own Alacritty exports, which
is why this source needs no verification pass of the kind
vendor/papercolor-theme exists to provide: unlike a third-party port, these
are published by the theme itself and carry its 16 ANSI slots, background,
foreground and selection directly.

Read at build time by readAlacrittyScheme in tools/external-scheme-sources.ts.
Build-time only, like every other vendor/ directory — nothing ships or reads
these at runtime. To update, vendor a newer pinned commit and update the SHA
above; do not hand-edit the files.

Alacritty carries no cursor colour unless a theme sets one and none of these
do, so the cursor is seeded from foreground — see the note in
external-scheme-sources.ts on why that is a sourced fallback rather than a
guess.
